name: Razorwind Canyon
summary: Dustwind harpies threaten travelers on Razorwind Canyon’s road between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar. The rocky gulch cuts through Durotar, making the route north toward the Horde capital dangerous.

sections.title: A Threat on the High Road
sections.body: Razorwind Canyon follows the main road from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar. Its gullies reach east into the bluffs and west toward Tor'kren Farm. Dustwind harpies roost among the rocks and attack travelers who stray too close. With the canyon so near the capital’s trade route, Durotar’s defenders must watch its gullies.

sections.title: Passages and Ravines
sections.body: Razorwind Canyon’s winding passages cut through Durotar’s red rock hills. One eastern branch runs deep into the crags, through a cavern, and into Drygulch Ravine. Harpies roost on high perches, then descend in flocks. Travelers crossing the passes can be surrounded and cut down.

faq.answer: Razorwind Canyon runs along both sides of the main road between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar in central Durotar. Entrances lie north of Razor Hill, near Tor'kren Farm, and through a cave leading to Drygulch Ravine.
Dustwind harpies inhabit Razorwind Canyon. They nest in its gullies and rocky outcroppings, preying on unwary travelers.

faq.q: Why is the Horde concerned about this canyon?
faq.answer: The Horde is concerned because Razorwind Canyon borders the main trade and travel route between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar. Nesting harpies harass couriers, supply caravans, and other travelers on the central road.

faq.q: Does Razorwind Canyon connect to other areas?
faq.answer: Yes. Razorwind Canyon opens onto the main road and has trails west toward Tor'kren Farm. An eastern cavern leads into Drygulch Ravine.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you know clearing Dustwind harpies from Razorwind Canyon helps keep the main road between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar safe for couriers and fresh recruits.
As an orc, you know harpies nesting beside Durotar’s central road threaten your homeland’s security. Young warriors must cull their numbers.
